properties.name: app.base-url
properties.description: Base URL of the server, used for constructing absolute URLs (e.g. profile image URLs).

properties.name: file.upload-dir
properties.description: Directory path where uploaded files (e.g. profile images) are stored.

properties.name: app.syllabus.max-file-size-mb
properties.description: Maximum allowed size (in MB) for an uploaded syllabus file.

properties.name: tesseract.datapath
properties.description: Path to the Tesseract OCR tessdata directory (contains trained language files).
